how: Show the new prompt and a Pattern box in plain words.
Show example 1 on the first tap and example 2 on the second tap.
Help me start puts the starter in the box for the learner to complete.

items.prompt: Write about something that was difficult at first, but now feels normal.
items.pattern: get used to + something / doing something
examples: It took me a few weeks to get used to working from home.
It took me a long time to get used to the cold weather.

items.prompt: Write about a decision you made. Are you happy about it now?
items.pattern: I've never regretted + doing something  ·  The biggest challenge was + something
examples: I've never regretted learning to drive.
The biggest challenge was finding a flat.

items.prompt: Write about a plan you have for this year.
items.pattern: I intend to ...  ·  I'm going to ...
examples: I intend to take an English exam in June.
I'm going to save money for a holiday.

items.prompt: Write about something you're excited about.
items.pattern: I'm looking forward to + something / doing something
examples: I'm looking forward to visiting my cousins in May.
I'm looking forward to the summer holidays.

items.prompt: Write one rule for a shared flat.
items.pattern: We have to / We don't have to / We should ...  ·  with arrange or routine
examples: We should arrange a time to clean the kitchen together.
We have to keep to a cleaning routine.

items.prompt: Write about someone you know well.
items.pattern: I get on (well) with + a person
items.starter: I get on well with ______ because ______ .
examples: I get on well with my neighbours, so we often chat in the lift.
I don't get on with my upstairs neighbour, because he's very noisy.

items.prompt: Write about a place in your town. Say what is done or sold there.
items.pattern: ______ is / are + sold, made, held, built…  ·  and use local
examples: Fresh fish is sold at the local market every morning.
Local cheese is made in the village near my town.

items.prompt: Tell a visitor about a custom or tradition in your town.
items.pattern: It's a tradition to ...  ·  It's a local custom to ...
items.starter: In my town, it's a tradition to ______ .
examples: In my town, visitors are invited to join the summer festival in August.
It's a local custom to eat grapes at midnight on New Year's Eve.
